# anthropic_environment (Resource)

Manages a Managed Agents environment: the container configuration (network policy and pre-installed packages) that sessions and deployments run in. Environment names are unique within a workspace. Configuration changes affect new sessions only.

`terraform destroy` deletes the environment (the API refuses while sessions reference it). Set `delete_on_destroy = false` to archive it instead.

~> The Managed Agents API is in beta. This resource needs `api_key` (a regular workspace API key, not an Admin key) and `workspace_id` when the key can reach more than one workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "anthropic_environment" "ci" {
  name        = "ci-runners"
  description = "Restricted network, Python tooling preinstalled"
  type        = "cloud"

  networking = {
    type                   = "limited"
    allowed_hosts          = ["api.example.com", "*.pypi.org"]
    allow_mcp_servers      = true
    allow_package_managers = true
  }

  packages = {
    pip = ["requests", "pyyaml"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name, 1 to 256 characters.
- `type` (String) `cloud` (Anthropic-hosted container) or `self_hosted`. Changing it forces a new environment.

### Optional

- `delete_on_destroy` (Boolean) Delete the environment on destroy (default `true`). When `false`, it is archived instead.
- `description` (String) Description, up to 1024 characters.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Key/value metadata, max 16 pairs.
- `networking` (Attributes) Network policy for `cloud` environments. Defaults to `{ type = "unrestricted" }`. Null for `self_hosted`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--networking))
- `packages` (Attributes) Packages pre-installed in `cloud` environments, per ecosystem. Under `limited` networking, `allow_package_managers` must be `true`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--packages))
- `scope` (String) `organization` (default) or `account`. Changing it forces a new environment.

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) Archive timestamp; null while live.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Environment id (`env_...`).
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC 3339).

<a id="nestedatt--networking"></a>
### Nested Schema for `networking`

Optional:

- `allow_mcp_servers` (Boolean) Allow traffic to the agent's MCP servers under `limited` networking.
- `allow_package_managers` (Boolean) Allow package-manager traffic under `limited` networking. Required when `packages` is set.
- `allowed_hosts` (List of String) Hosts reachable under `limited` networking (bare host or `*.example.com`).
- `type` (String) `unrestricted` or `limited`.


<a id="nestedatt--packages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `packages`

Optional:

- `apt` (List of String) Packages installed with `apt`.
- `cargo` (List of String) Packages installed with `cargo`.
- `gem` (List of String) Packages installed with `gem`.
- `go` (List of String) Packages installed with `go`.
- `npm` (List of String) Packages installed with `npm`.
- `pip` (List of String) Packages installed with `pip`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import anthropic_environment.ci env_01ExampleEnvId000000000000
```
